title: Seacrest Beach "Magnolia Mermaid" 18 Olivia Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Walking distance to the beach- Community pool- Gas grill- 3 adult bikes- Screened-in porch- Parking for 2 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Tucked away in the heart of Seacrest Beach, Magnolia Mermaid is a peaceful single-story retreat made for relaxation and good times. Perfectly located, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home is a quick 5-minute stroll or 2-minute bike ride from the white sand beach and sparkling community pool. Delight in grilling fresh fish on the gas grill, unwind on the cozy screened-in porch, and explore the area on complimentary bikes—it’s a flawless coastal escape for 8!Step into a welcoming screened-in porch, where vibrant plush seating, a cozy bench swing, and a refreshing ceiling fan set the tone for a relaxing getaway. Start the day with early-morning coffee or wind down at night with friends and family. Inside, soothing natural tones and warm wood floors define the great room, while navy accents and shiplap details complete the coastal-inspired design. Gather on the L-shaped sectional and matching armchairs in the living area to enjoy movie nights, share the day’s beach stories, or simply relax. The adjoining dining area separates the living and kitchen spaces and features a rustic wood table with cushioned benches for the whole group. The open galley kitchen, perfect for conversation and creativity, boasts high-end appliances and a long island that serves as both a functional workspace with built-in features and a cozy breakfast bar for 4. An outdoor gas grill adds convenience. Unwind with a post-beach nap in the 3 peaceful bedrooms, including 2 elegant primary bedrooms—the first offers a plush king bed and private bathroom with a shower, while the second bedroom features a spacious queen bed and private bathroom with a convenient shower/tub combination. Finally, the guest bedroom is a welcoming retreat with 2 full beds, a shared bathroom with a shower, and easy access to the charming front porch, where beach days end in comfort and style.Magnolia Mermaid offers ample space to gather and create lasting memories along the stunning Emerald Coast. With parking for 2 vehicles and 3 complimentary bikes, it’s easy to explore the Timpoochee Trail, dine at Pescado Seafood Grill, or visit The Hub on 30A. For beach access, head down Patina Blvd, turn left onto Hwy 30A, and the beach will be on the right—only a quick 2-minute bike ride or 5-minute stroll! Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 8):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Primary Bedroom 2: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: 2 Full Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
